name: project-workflow
description: Plan complex software projects, wait for explicit approval, then execute the confirmed plan with durable state and validation.

interface.shortDescription: Plan first, require approval, then execute safely.
interface.longDescription: A durable project workflow for complex software changes. It separates planning from execution, requires explicit user approval, validates persisted workflow state, and records test and delivery evidence.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use Project Workflow to plan this complex software change, wait for my approval, and then execute the confirmed plan.
